usedBikesLanding.seoHeading: Used bikes for sale — buy with confidence
usedBikesLanding.seoP1: Whether you are upgrading from a 70cc commuter or hunting for a heavy bike, BanglarChaka brings transparent listings with photos, mileage and location so you can shortlist quickly.
usedBikesLanding.seoP2: Filter by city, budget and keywords like "125cc" or "self start". Save time versus scrolling unstructured groups — every listing opens into a full detail page with seller contact.
usedBikesLanding.seoP3: Posting is free: upload angles of the odometer, documents you are willing to share, and a fair price. Serious buyers prefer honest descriptions and daylight photos.
usedBikesLanding.seoP4: Explore commuter favourites like CB Shine and Splendor, sporty Pulsar and Apache lines, scooters and imported heavy bikes — all in one Bangladesh marketplace.

sellItForMePage.protocolHeading: How Sell It For Me works
sellItForMePage.protocolLead: Same idea as marketplace “we sell for you” programmes: you share accurate details, we coordinate inspection, the listing, and serious buyers — you stay in control of the final price.
sellItForMePage.pilotNote: Pilot availability — limited cities & slots. Our team confirms coverage after you submit your city and car details.

steps.title: Car information
steps.body: Tell us make, model, year, variant, mileage, and overall condition — via the form or a quick callback from support.

steps.title: Contact & city
steps.body: Share your phone number and location so we can confirm pilot slots and whether inspection can be scheduled in your area.

steps.title: Service confirmation
steps.body: We explain the Sell It For Me package, timeline, and any service fee before you commit — nothing goes live without your OK.

steps.title: Professional inspection
steps.body: We book a visit: photos, structured checklist, and a short condition summary so remote buyers can decide with confidence.

steps.title: Premium listing
steps.body: We draft the ad, apply featured-style placement where the programme allows, and you approve the asking price before it is published.

steps.title: Buyer handling & handover
steps.body: We filter enquiries, arrange serious viewings, and support negotiation through to payment and handover — with your approval at key steps.
